notes.title: Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[u]Patch Notes – Version 1.1.0[/u]

[list]
[*] Added support for Bluetooth controllers.
[*] Optimized input modes.
[*] Updated internal libraries.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who reached out through the Steam community hub.
We truly appreciate your feedback and will be happy to implement any improvements needed to ensure everyone enjoys the best possible experience with Easy Controller.
